note: Marisa's own hat as a dry vessel: wall thickness, the aquatic hat's size, where the braid grips the brim, the lying cradle's young seats, the boat's freeboard and seats, how the helper is placed beside the lying hat, and the pregnant body used to find the live-birth exit. Model units (16 per block) at growth 1.
aquatic_scale_lore: the aquatic Marisa's hat is made larger than a land Marisa's so it carries her young and food as a small dry boat (user, 2026-10-14)
grip_lore: the braid hooks the brim's outer edge on its own side, as in the saved braid interactions (v2 takes the hat by one brim point): behind the ear when she lays the hat down beside her, at the front corner when she sets it before herself; on the larger aquatic hat nearer the crown, so the scaled brim point stays in reach

float.lore: at a bank the aquatic Marisa catches in her hat floated at the water's edge before the outlet, its near brim slipped under the bank; a newborn pushed too hard flies past it into the river (user, 2026-10-14). bank_drop: water surface below the bank top (a full water block under a dry one)

boat.seat_lore: afloat the mother sits on the rim at the stern; by day the young ride in the dry well before her, at night they sleep in the well under her (user, 2026-10-14)

helper.lore: the helper stands beside the opening, at the end of the lying brim, where the braid holds the rim and the mother is in view

pregnancy.lore: LiveBirthGeometry.deform: the whole body grows larger and the lower front fills out (CADあき 图001: the lower body swells while hair and bow keep their place); the face is moved, not stretched. Used here for the live exit (body half width at a full belly)
